name: New User Onboarding
primary_user_goal: Create an account and start investing as quickly as possible
business_goal: Convert visitors into funded accounts with minimal drop-off
entry_point: Landing page or app store download
exit_point: Funded account with first trade completed
ux_notes: Robinhood's onboarding is a benchmark in fintech UX. The one-question-per-screen approach breaks down a complex KYC process into digestible steps. Real-time validation reduces errors. The flow prioritizes speed to first trade, with bank linking and full verification happening in parallel where possible.

name: Portfolio Monitoring
primary_user_goal: Check portfolio performance and stay informed about investments
business_goal: Maximize engagement and time-in-app to increase trading likelihood
exit_point: App close or transition to trading flow
ux_notes: The portfolio home is designed for quick status checks and deeper exploration. The interactive chart encourages engagement through scrubbing. Real-time updates create a dynamic feel but may encourage over-checking. The design has been criticized for gamifying portfolio monitoring.

name: Stock Research
primary_user_goal: Gather information to make informed investment decisions
business_goal: Convert research activity into executed trades
friction_points: Limited advanced research tools compared to traditional brokerages
Simplified metrics may not satisfy advanced users
ux_notes: Research features are deliberately simplified to avoid overwhelming beginners. Key metrics are curated and presented simply. Analyst ratings provide social proof. The persistent 'Trade' button creates a clear path from research to action. More advanced users may find the tools insufficient.

name: Buy/Sell Execution
business_goal: Complete transactions with minimal abandonment and maximum satisfaction
entry_point: Trade button on stock detail or portfolio
exit_point: Order confirmation and return to portfolio
ux_notes: The trading flow is optimized for speed and simplicity. Dollar-based buying (fractional shares) is more intuitive than share quantities for beginners. The review step provides a moment of reflection without adding significant friction. Post-trade celebration (confetti) has been controversial for potentially encouraging trading.

name: Stock Discovery
business_goal: Expand user portfolios and increase trading volume
exit_point: Stock detail page or watchlist addition
ux_notes: Discovery is designed to help users who don't know what to invest in. Curated collections and trending lists provide starting points. This approach has been criticized for potentially encouraging herd behavior and FOMO-driven trading. The search auto-complete is fast and comprehensive.

name: Deposit and Withdrawal
primary_user_goal: Move money into or out of the Robinhood account
business_goal: Increase assets under management and reduce withdrawal friction
ux_notes: Money movement is streamlined through Plaid integration and instant deposits. Recurring deposits encourage consistent investing behavior. The interface clearly communicates transfer timelines. Robinhood Gold's higher instant deposit limits are promoted as an upsell.

name: Account Settings
primary_user_goal: Manage personal information, security, and preferences
business_goal: Enable self-service while promoting premium features
ux_notes: Settings are well-organized with progressive disclosure. Security features are promoted but not forced. Robinhood Gold upsells are present but not aggressive. Tax documents and account statements are easily accessible. The interface handles complex account states (margin, options approval) gracefully.
